connector.name: Cursor Proxmox MCP
connector.registryDescription: Manage Proxmox VE via Cursor: QEMU, LXC, storage, HA, firewall, access.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package cursor-proxmox-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the hackmods account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
